_comment: Currencies this deployment will accept on a payment request. The X9.150 payload format is
currency-agnostic and carries any code verbatim, but a deployment can only honour what its
payment rails settle. The US bank rails (FedNow, RTP, ACH) move USD; Solana settles USDC, the
dollar-pegged stablecoin it is overwhelmingly used for. Both are listed, and pegged-currencies.json
already groups them, so a single QR Code may offer a USD bank method and a USDC Solana method
side by side. A code that is not listed is refused at creation rather than advertised on a QR
Code nobody can pay. Add one here when a rail that settles it is added. An empty "supported"
array disables the check entirely. This '_comment' key is documentation only and is ignored by
the loader, keeping the file strict, standard JSON.
